hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8

arms.qualified: SalesIntel's daily list (act now and this week): an evidenced requirement for a service the profile sells, or an existing relationship
arms.exploratory: SalesIntel's exploratory list: a sourced organisation, site or commercial change; need not confirmed
arms.pr8: The daily list as PR #8 built it
arms.keyword: Leads whose own source text names a fire or security system

protocol.sampling: A simple random sample of up to 10 leads per arm from its own list, with a seed fixed in the sealed key. A lead sampled by two arms is judged once and counts in both. Excluded from every frame: leads in the withdrawn v1 set, and leads that v1's published documents or screenshots show with the method that found them.
protocol.blinding: Reviewers see only the source records: no arm, rank, tier, reasons, summary, service list or inferences. Order and ids use a secret salt.
protocol.completion: At least two independent complete reviews per item; every disagreement on relevance, reason or pursue adjudicated with a recorded method (consensus or an independent third reviewer) and rationale; then the set is locked before the key is revealed.

measures.actionable: Worth pursuing this week or month
measures.worth_investigating: A reason to contact, worth pursuing at some point
measures.noise: Not relevant, or not worth pursuing

protocol.statistics: Wilson 95% intervals per arm; Newcombe intervals for differences at z = 2.4977 (Bonferroni over each family of four). Shared leads make arms positively correlated, so these intervals are conservative. A difference is claimed only if the adjusted interval excludes zero.
protocol.exploratory_rule: The exploratory pathway is supported as useful if at least 30% of its sampled leads are judged worth investigating.

withdrawn.reason: Its key was published in a public repository before any judgement; it was never reviewed.
